resources.string: Carom sends notifications and your clipboard between your own devices. Everything is end-to-end encrypted.
It runs through your own Hub: a free Cloudflare Worker you set up once with npx carom-hub deploy.
Is this your first device with Carom?
This is my first device. I have the code from npx carom-hub deploy.
Carom already runs on another device. It will show me a code.
Run npx carom-hub deploy on your computer. It shows a code that starts with carom://setup.
Scan the code on your other device
On a paired device, open Add device. Then scan the code it shows.
Carom uses the camera only to read the code, and only on this screen.
Camera access is off. Turn it on in Settings, or paste the code below.
Camera view for scanning the code
That isn\'t a Carom code. Use the code that starts with carom://.
The clipboard has no text. Copy the code first.
Your other device asks whether to add this one. Check that it shows the same code.
Check your internet connection and try again.
This Hub is already set up
Join instead: on a device that is already paired, open Add device and scan its code.
Your Hub didn\'t accept this code. Copy the newest code from npx carom-hub deploy and try again.
The other device didn\'t add this one, or the Hub refused it. Show a new code on your other device and scan it again.
Codes work for 5 minutes and for one device. Show a new code on your other device and scan it.
Carom stopped before anything was shared. Show a new code on your other device and scan it again.
Your Hub returned an error. Try again in a moment.
Your other devices show this name.
Carom needs these to forward notifications. You can change them later in Settings.
Lets Carom read notifications so it can forward them to your other devices.
Switch greyed out? Open App info, tap ⋮, then Allow restricted settings. Android asks for this when an app comes from outside an app store.
Lets Carom tell you when a clipboard item arrives from another device.
Carom uses little battery and works without this. On some phones it helps notifications go out without delay. Find Carom in the list and choose Don\'t optimise.
Android 15 and later hides one-time codes from notification apps. Allow Carom to see them so you can copy a code on your computer.
Carom now syncs notifications and your clipboard. Add more devices from the home screen.
